obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, primary background — the floor everything sits on

carbon.$description: Carbon — Card and elevated surface — one step up from canvas for contained blocks

graphite.$description: Graphite — Borders, dividers, inset surfaces, nav background — the structural neutral

filament.$description: Filament — Hairline borders on badges, tags, and outlined controls — the machined edge

paper.$description: Paper — Primary text, filled CTA background, icon strokes — the highest contrast signal

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary text, subdued body copy, card labels

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, badge captions, metadata

mist.$description: Mist — Tertiary text, icon strokes, disabled-state foreground

silver.$description: Silver — Decorative icon strokes, product-mock accent lines

slate.$description: Slate — Deep icon fills, secondary button text, sparse accent

sleet.$description: Sleet — Code editor chrome, light surface insets, inverted card fill

neon-cyan.$description: Neon Cyan — Blue text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

beacon-teal.$description: Beacon Teal — Glow halo behind hero product imagery, soft radial accent

amber.$description: Amber — Decorative icon accent, editorial highlight — the warm counterpoint to cyan

inter.$description: Primary interface and editorial type — headlines at weight 500 with aggressive negative tracking (up to -0.05em at 68px) create display density without heaviness; body at 400 reads cleanly against Obsidian canvas

commitmono.$description: Code-first monospace — terminal commands, file labels, badge text, inline code snippets; 13–14px range keeps code as peer to body copy rather than as ornamental detail

apple-system.$description: Email preview rendering — the email itself uses system font stack so rendered output matches recipient inbox; liga features disabled to keep copy neutral
